title: Dental and aesthetic services in Albania | European Dental
description: Dental treatment, aesthetic surgery and hair transplants: the care we arrange with certified clinics in Albania, from the first question to aftercare.
lead: Quality and care for your needs

dental.title: Dental treatment
dental.text: Restorative dentistry, modern orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry, general dentistry.

aesthetic.title: Aesthetic surgery
aesthetic.text: Cosmetic and functional rhinoplasty, septoplasty (correcting a deviated nasal septum), otoplasty (correcting protruding or asymmetric ears).

hair.title: Hair transplant
hair.text: Advanced techniques: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) and DHI (Direct Hair Implantation). Complementary treatments and post-operative care.
